definitions.explanation: Both parents together. More formal than {両親|りょうしん}.

examples.japanese: {父母|ふぼ}に{感謝|かんしゃ}している。
examples.english: I am grateful to my parents.

examples.japanese: {父母|ふぼ}{会|かい}に{出席|しゅっせき}した。
{父母|ふぼ}の{恩|おん}は{深|ふか}い。
examples.english: The debt of gratitude to one's parents is deep.

notes:
USAGE: Formal written term for parents. {両親|りょうしん} is more common in everyday speech.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{父母|ふぼ}{会|かい} (PTA meeting, parents' association)
・{祖|そ}{父母|ふぼ} (grandparents)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{両親|りょうしん} - parents (more common in speech)
・お{父|とう}さんとお{母|かあ}さん - father and mother (casual)
・{親|おや} - parent(s) (general term)

NOTE: Can also be read as ちちはは in some contexts, though ふぼ is more common.
